purpose: Separate the organiser Tier A items used to author the official CMS-1500 (02-12) template from the items reserved for a single untouched scoring run.
selection_basis: Safe published metadata only (linkage status, linkage margin, field-population ratio) from eval/official/results/official_sample_rows.jsonl. No page pixels, crops, or expected values were read to make this selection.
selection_rule: Among deterministically linked items with linkage margin >= 10, take the lowest, median, and highest field-population ratio so the development subset spans the observed population range.
immutability_note: Items must never move between development and holdout. Any change invalidates every holdout result produced under this split_id and requires a new split_id.

development.rationale: Strongest linkage in Tier A and the page already inspected during root-cause diagnosis; keeping it in development prevents prior inspection from contaminating the holdout.
Median field population with a high linkage margin.
Densest field population; exercises boxes left blank on the other two development pages.

excluded.reason: Linkage abstained with score 0 and no present fields. Excluded from development, holdout, and every accuracy denominator.
